findings.text: §4 says it "re-runs `scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py` unchanged", yet that file's module docstring (`scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:4-5` "draws the 27 `magnetics/flux_loop/flux` traces FL1-FL27"; `:13-15` "loop 7 is absolute and every other loop is the measured difference relative to loop 7, stored with its measured sign") describes the pre-§4 output, so an unchanged re-run lands a figure whose own docstring is false: the panels are labelled `FL1-FL7 … FL27-FL7` and the stored value is the data dictionary's `ψ_L − ψ_7`, not the measured sign
